test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The authorities __are assured__ the people that they will look into the matter.
solution:
The correct answer is **'have assured'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'have assured' **should be used instead of 'are assured'.&
